name: open-overheid
description: Toolkit for Dutch and Amsterdam open government data: CBS StatLine statistics for every municipality, district and neighbourhood, council meetings and documents (NotuBiz), zoning plans (PDOK/KOOP), court rulings (ECLI), official publications (KOOP SRU), Amsterdam key figures (BBGA), Woo/FOI decisions (open.amsterdam) and the Amsterdam subsidy register. Works with Gemini (Antigravity) and Claude.
